name: Das Kofel
kurzbeschreibung: **The Kofel in Patsch** – a majestic mountain peak in the heart of **Tirol**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, offering breathtaking views of the **Inn Valley** and the **Karwendel** mountain range. Whether you're hiking, climbing, or simply enjoying the fresh alpine air, this iconic summit promises unforgettable experiences year-round. In winter, it’s a paradise for skiers and snowboarders, while summer brings lush meadows perfect for picnics and mountain hikes. Don’t miss the cozy mountain huts along the way, where you can refuel with hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn** and **Speckknödel** after your adventure.
